The first goodbyes

Departures

The first goodbyes

Every mobility ends the way it started — with suitcases by the door. This week the group began to thin out. One by one, friends packed up, hugged everyone twice, and set off down the road back to their homes.

Leaving behind

Empty chairs at CJ

The dinner table at Casa da Juventude felt bigger each night. Seats that were loud last week sat quiet. You only notice how much someone fills a room once their chair is empty.

The road

Watching them drive off

Hard moments, but also beautiful ones. We are grateful for the time we had with them. Specially with Brandor. One of our friends that made this experience so special and we are so grateful for it. We will miss them, but for sure, we will meet again.

Home

Carrying memories

Everyone that left, took a piece of Amarante with them. We hope meeting us was a nice experience because this memories will be something that we won't experience again. But we won't be sad because it ended, we will be happy because it happened. And we will keep these memories alive in our hearts.
